const payload = $input.first().json || {};

const user = payload.user || {};
const activeSession = payload.session || payload.active_session || {};
const input = payload.input || {};
const meta = payload.meta || {};

const file = input.file || payload.file || null;

return [
  {
    json: {
      request_id: payload.request_id || null,
      channel: payload.channel || "telegram",

      user,

      active_session: activeSession,

      input,

      meta,

      has_file: file ? 1 : 0,

      file: file
        ? {
            telegram_file_id: file.channel_file_id || null,
            channel_file_id: file.channel_file_id || null,
            file_unique_id: file.file_unique_id || null,
            file_name: file.file_name || null,
            mime_type: file.mime_type || null,
            file_size: file.file_size || null,
            source: file.source || null
          }
        : null,

      // بيانات استخراج الملف
      telegram_file_path: payload.telegram_file_path || null,
      file_type: payload.file_type || null,

      raw_text: payload.raw_text || "",
      clean_text: payload.clean_text || payload.raw_text || "",
      extracted_text:
        payload.extracted_text ||
        payload.clean_text ||
        payload.raw_text ||
        "",

      extraction_method:
        payload.extraction_method ||
        "unknown",

      text_length:
        Number(payload.text_length || 0),

      has_enough_text:
        Number(payload.has_enough_text || 0),

      extracted_links:
        payload.extracted_links || {},

      links_count:
        Number(payload.links_count || 0),

      emails_count:
        Number(payload.emails_count || 0),

      phones_count:
        Number(payload.phones_count || 0)
    }
  }
];

UPDATE user_sessions
SET
  context_json = '{{ String($json.context_json_string || "{}").replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  last_message_type = '{{ String(($json.request && $json.request.input && $json.request.input.type) ? $json.request.input.type : "file").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE id = {{ Number($json.active_session.id || 0) }};

INSERT INTO user_files (
  user_id,
  session_id,
  channel,
  channel_file_id,
  file_unique_id,
  file_name,
  mime_type,
  file_size,
  purpose,
  status,
  extracted_text,
  storage_url,
  metadata_json
)
VALUES (
  {{ Number($json.user.id) }},
  {{ $json.active_session?.id ? Number($json.active_session.id) : 'NULL' }},
  {{ JSON.stringify("telegram") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.file.channel_file_id || "") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.file.file_unique_id || "") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.file.file_name || "") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.file.mime_type || "") }},
  {{ Number($json.file.file_size || 0) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify("cv_upload") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify("processed") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.clean_text || $json.raw_text || "") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.telegram_file_path || "") }},
  {{ JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({
    raw_text: $json.raw_text || "",
    text_length: Number($json.text_length || 0),
    has_enough_text: Number($json.has_enough_text || 0),
    extraction_method: $json.extraction_method || ""
  })) }}
);
